## Cathy O’Mara — the *Home Alone* train passenger

Cathy O’Mara is a small G4 *Friendship Is Magic* background Earth-pony mare: the peach-coated, turquoise-eyed passenger with a curled auburn mane and tan coat, seated by a window on the Friendship Express. She is a visual homage to **Kate McCallister**, Catherine O’Hara’s character in *Home Alone*, rather than Kate herself in a shared continuity. The two stallions behind her parody Steve Martin’s and John Candy’s travelers from *Planes, Trains and Automobiles*. A [2015 viewer spotted the movie references](https://www.fimfiction.net/blog/554320/my-reaction-to-hearthbreakers-yay-references).

[![Cathy O’Mara sitting at the left window on the Friendship Express](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/2020/7/23/1947703/medium.png)](https://twibooru.org/1947703)

*Show still from “Hearthbreakers”; animation produced for Hasbro’s series. The linked Twibooru post includes the screencap’s tags and original Derpibooru reference.*

**Name and voice.** “Cathy O’Mara” is an **unofficial placeholder/fandom name** combining *Cathy* (Catherine O’Hara) with a variation on her surname, not a name spoken in the show. Gameloft’s licensed mobile game instead calls her **Traveling Mare**, one of the **Homebound Ponies**, and jokes that she worries she forgot her suitcase or train ticket. This game name is licensed-media usage, not evidence of spoken TV canon. No dialogue or identifiable voice actor is documented for her. See the [Homebound Ponies character and game account](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Homebound_Ponies).

**Appearances.** She is seen in *Hearthbreakers* (S5E20, 2015) and *The Gift of the Maud Pie* (S6E03, 2016), both aboard the Friendship Express. The group also appears in the *The Reason for the Season* storybook adaptation. Later sightings of her two male traveling companions should not be mistaken for additional confirmed appearances by Cathy.

## Important moments

1. **A holiday-movie Easter egg — “Hearthbreakers” (S5E20).** Cathy gazes out of the train window while the Apples and Pies travel for Hearth’s Warming; the arrangement reveals the *Home Alone* and *Planes, Trains and Automobiles* tribute. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q2xWLmCcSgM) (*scene timestamp unavailable; the upload’s episode-number label differs from the standard S5E20 listing*).
2. **The returning traveler — “The Gift of the Maud Pie” (S6E03).** She appears again on the train near the episode’s opening, rewarding viewers who noticed the earlier visual joke. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FvnhONrbSrA) (*scene timestamp unavailable*).

*These are visual cameo moments, not speaking parts or plot-changing decisions; none are documented for this character.*
